text:
elena_cs: Morning team — quick status check for Lumina private/VPC onboarding. Main asks today: (1) confirm egress firewall rules for log-forwarder, (2) IAM role mapping for service accounts, (3) KMS key policy + rotation window, (4) audit logs retention/forwarding. Pinged infra, sec, and KMS. Any blockers?

derek_net: Good morning. I pulled the network diagram from their infra. Two immediate notes: their log-forwarder sits in a private subnet with NAT — we need 3 egress destinations allowed: s3 endpoint, splunk ingest host, and our telemetry-collector fqdn.

derek_net: Proposed SG snippet (they're on AWS):
```
Type: egress
Protocol: TCP
Ports: 443
Destinations:
  - vpce-0a1b2c3d (s3)
  - 54.23.45.67/32 (splunk.ingest.lumina.com)
  - telemetry.redwood-internal.net:443
```

derek_net: Also flagged that their subnet has a 0.0.0.0/0 egress route to a shared NAT that we want to avoid long-term. Suggest we gate the outbound via the VPC endpoint + explicit routes.

elena_cs: Copy. @sam_platform can we get a config suggestion for the VPC endpoint + route table change? This is a pre-prod cutover so low blast, but want minimal ops. :eyes:

sam_platform: Yep, will draft. Two quick Qs: do they want logs copied to their S3 or to our central bucket (or both)? That affects the KMS envelope key strategy.

elena_cs: Customer prefers copy to their S3 (for retention/compliance) and also a mirror to our central telemetry for rollups. They asked about key access for our aggregator — we should propose a cross-account decrypt role.

raul_kms: For KMS: recommend customer creates a symmetric CMK in their account, with a key policy that grants a limited IAM role in our aggregation account Decrypt permissions. Rotation: auto-rotate yearly is fine by default; if they need quarterly we can accommodate but call out cost of re-encrypting any archived content.

marta_sec: On IAM mapping: We need an IAM role that our service assumes via STS. Minimal permissions: kms:Decrypt on the CMK ARN, s3:GetObject for the telemetry prefix, and logs:PutLogEvents if they push to CloudWatch. Also require a condition for aws:SourceIp or aws:SourceVpc to constrain.

marta_sec: Also capture audit requirement: they want 3 years retention for audit logs in a WORM bucket. We should confirm if they need log immutability — that changes S3 lifecycle and legal hold processes.

elena_cs: Noted. I asked the customer about WORM; reply was "we need tamper-evident retention for 3 years, legal hold TBD".

louis_eng: Small ops ask: our private agent needs a TLS client cert to authenticate to their ingest host. Do they have an mTLS gateway? If not, we can switch to signed JWTs but that will require an extra config.

elena_cs: They're using an appliance that supports mutual TLS. I'll ask them to share a CSR process or let us upload the cert.

ops-bot: (automated) Reminder: cutover runbook meeting at 15:00 PT today. Link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/priv-onboard-lumina

elena_cs: Agenda for the runbook meeting: final SG rules, role ARN for cross-account decrypt, S3 bucket policy for telemetry mirror, audit retention SLA, and a dry-run for ingest.

sam_platform: I attached a short terraform snippet in thread for the VPC endpoint + route table change we can give them as a patch: 
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  route_table_ids = var.route_table_ids
}
```

sam_platform: Will also prepare an example assume-role policy for the cross-account decrypt role and post before the 15:00 meeting.

elena_cs: Awesome. Blocker list right now: (A) customer to confirm WORM/legal-hold requirement, (B) they to provide splunk host cert details for mTLS, (C) agree on CMK ARN + confirm rotation cadence. Everything else we can handle in meeting.

derek_net: One more note — they're currently sampling a lot of telemetry which inflates cost. Recommend asking them to enable prefix filtering at source for the first 72 hours during ramp.

louis_eng: Agreed, prefix filter + 1:10 sampling for non-critical traces. We'll turn it down after day 3.

elena_cs: I'll log these as action items and capture in the runbook doc after the call. Thanks everyone — see you at 15:00 PT. :thumbsup:

raul_kms: Posting a KMS policy template in the meeting notes channel after sync.

marta_sec: I'll follow up on the audit retention policy wording and the S3 bucket ACLs we need to avoid.

elena_cs: Perfect — if any of you get the cert/CMK ARN before the meeting, drop here and I'll update the runbook.

ops-bot: (automated) Thread closed for inactivity after 1 hour. If there are new messages, it will reopen. :bell:
